glosses: unwillingly; usually expressed in English through verb phrases such as "doesn't like", "don't want", etc.

examples.text: Ich weiß, wie ungern du das tust.
examples.en: I know how much you hate doing that.

examples.text: Ich esse wirklich sehr ungern allein.
Sie ging ihn nur ungern besuchen.
examples.en: She went to see him reluctantly.

examples.text: So was tue ich äußerst ungern.
examples.en: I hate doing things like this.
